visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light blue button-down shirt, stands in a kitchen. She holds a small glass of tiramisu in her right hand and a white ceramic tray of cinnamon rolls in her left. The background is a soft-focus kitchen with shelves and plants. (2) Close-up shots of the foods are interspersed with playful graphics. One graphic shows the woman's face superimposed on the Statue of Liberty head with blue and red polka dot background. Another shows her face on the head of a David statue against a red and green background. (3) A large flour bag labeled 'My Dear 麥典' is the focus. A miniature version of the woman is animated to appear to push and tear the bag open. The scene takes place on a white kitchen counter under bright, natural-looking indoor lighting. (4) Hands are seen pouring white flour into a glass bowl, followed by dry yeast, honey, milk, and eggs. A pink spatula is used to mix the ingredients into a shaggy dough. (5) The woman kneads the dough manually on the counter, pushing and folding it rhythmically. Close-ups show the texture of the dough becoming smoother. Text overlays describe the kneading technique. (6) The dough is placed in a transparent bowl and put inside an electronic proofing oven. A finger pokes the risen dough, leaving an indentation. (7) In a glass bowl, butter, brown sugar, cocoa powder, and cinnamon powder are mixed. A whisk is used to combine them into a dark brown paste. (8) A wooden rolling pin flattens the dough into a large rectangle. A metal ruler measures the dimensions. The brown filling is spread evenly across the dough with a metal offset spatula. (9) The dough is rolled into a long cylinder. A piece of white dental floss is used to slice the roll into individual portions, which are then placed into a rectangular baking dish. (10) The rolls are shown inside the oven, expanding and browning. After baking, a gloved hand removes the tray. (11) Coffee beans are crushed inside a plastic bag with a rolling pin. The crushed beans are steeped in cream, then strained. A hand mixer whips the mixture until stiff peaks form. (12) The cream mixture is piped in swirls onto the centers of the baked cinnamon rolls. Cocoa powder is dusted over them using a sifter. (13) The woman takes a large bite of a finished roll. Animated graphics show her in an emperor's outfit, and later with motifs again as she reacts to the flavor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music starts immediately. A female voice introduce the dessert dilemma with high arousal and a clear, friendly tone. (2) A 'Pop' sound effect triggers as the flour bag is presented. The narrator details the features of the 'My Dear' brand flour with professional broadcasting clarity. (3) The sound of liquid pouring into dry flour is audible, followed by the soft clinking of a spatula against glass. BGM remains steady and rhythmic. (4) Percussive slapping sounds and muffled thuds increase in frequency as dough is kneaded. The narrator shouts 'Hey! Hey! Hey!' rhythmically to match the visual action. (5) Whisking sounds and the scraping of a spoon signify the filling and cream preparation. A brief digital chime accompanies a text overlay. (6) Sharp cracking sounds occur as coffee beans are crushed. A mechanical whirring from a hand mixer swells, then levels out as the narration continues. (7) The BGM transitions to a catchy vocal track with the lyrics 'Cinnamon Tiramisu'. The narrator's tone becomes more playful and comedic. (8) Crisp 'crunch' and swallowing sounds are emphasized during the tasting section. A final energetic stinger and a 'whoosh' transition sound conclude the audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Sponsor Intro -> Step-by-step Tutorial -> Result -> Tasting Reaction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a creative cooking tutorial and brand endorsement for 'My Dear' flour. It uses a high-energy, variety-show style to demonstrate a unique hybrid recipe ('Cinnamon Tiramisu Rolls'). The narrator guides the audience through technical baking steps while maintaining an entertaining persona using animated graphics and rhythmic editing to keep viewers engaged with both the process and the sponsored product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Dedicated product segment with bag opening, brand name '麥典' prominently displayed, and detailed explanation of product benefits like 'Clean Label'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends high-production instructional content with social-media native memes and graphics, creating a fast-paced and cheerful atmosphere. The use of specialized sound design for kneading and mixing enhances the sensory appeal.
